rehearsal.ranFrom: a clean checkout of the release commit on a GitHub runner, with --ci-run naming the producer CI run

inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.17.0: 86 paths, 42 of them under new names: the twenty locale chunks and their maps, which add search.allEntries, and the assets and symbols declaration chunks, whose content-hashed names move with the declarations they hold. dist/index.js, its map and dist/index.d.ts change for search.filters, DatafeedSearchOptions.filters and SearchPage.filterCounts, and dist/index.js stands a search with filters 184px wider; dist/quickcharts.css adds the filters column, its chips at narrow widths and its scrollbar; dist/drawings.d.ts and dist/symbols.d.ts change only to name the renamed chunks; the feature manifest and package.json change the version; README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the change. The export map, the drawings, adapters and helper entrypoints, the shared chunks, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, the theme manifest and the REST description are byte for byte unchanged.

ownerWaiver.question: Quick Charts 5.18.0 had a regression: its new filters column took 184px out of the symbol search's results. PR #222 fixes it by widening a search with filters to 1024px, and its CI passed. That changes the release tarball's sha256 from d8a0df8d…3387 to c3b0b94ca7d1e6da11fee9268932b19531698ddb974b812c1738fc6368f56649. May I merge #222, then tag v5.18.0, run release.yml with the new sha256 and approve the npm publish? / You waived the manual accessibility and browser/device checks for Quick Charts 5.18.0. The automated browser suites passed again on the new tarball in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Does the waiver also cover the new tarball (c3b0b94c…6649)?
ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Answered by the owner in the session that runs this release. Manual accessibility and advertised browser and device acceptance were not performed; the browser suites passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
